title: Tretyakov Gallery, historic Lavrushinsky Lane complex
visualBrief: Historic Lavrushinsky Lane Tretyakov Gallery and contiguous northern gallery range: original connected map footprint, orange-red rendered walls, cream inscription panels without copied text, dark patterned frieze, raised gray keeled central facade with arched lights/abstract relief, three scalloped entrance gables and a genuine recessed central arched doorway, and repeated framed glazed roof lanterns. Exterior only. Preserve the independent engineering building, church, modern detached gallery and neighbors. No furnished galleries, paintings, statue likeness, copied signs, lettering or heraldic artwork.

sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped14m tags are unqualified. Working body10.4m/cornice11.3m, roof lanterns to14.7m and central keeled facade to16.6m are photo-led estimates. Main facade and three-gable entrance use the viewed silhouette; arched windows, abstract relief, tile/color bands and roof framework simplified. Hidden rear elevations and lantern count/layout are reconstructed inside the mapped footprint; no claim of measured historical roof layout.
